title: Grogu
description: Push-to-talk dictation app for Windows with a Star Wars-inspired interface. Transcription runs locally on-device (faster-whisper on CUDA) with a model-free rules engine for cleanup - no cloud, no LLM required. Includes a custom dictionary and learns from corrections.

title: Road Monitor
description: Cross-platform mobile proof of concept that detects possible road impacts (potholes, speed bumps, cracks) from phone accelerometer/gyroscope and GPS data, then maps and classifies events for road authorities using OpenStreetMap tiles.

title: Financial Java API
description: Spring Boot-based financial transactions API with full CRUD endpoints, date-range reporting with sorting and pagination, and field-level filtering - built to practice REST API design patterns used in banking systems.

title: imp
description: A small customizable desktop companion that reacts to your workflow in real time - sleeping when idle, thinking when you're working, and celebrating when a task finishes. Runs as an always-on-top desktop pet.

title: Smart Pothole Detection
description: Led a team of 4 to design and implement a sensor and computer-vision-based pothole detection and prediction model, achieving 72% accuracy.

title: Robot Movement Automation with Computer Vision
description: Designed an autonomous robot navigation system integrating ESP8266, NodeMCU, OpenCV, Unity3D, and Arduino IDE using SIFT feature matching, reducing system latency by 30% and improving industrial process efficiency by 45%.
